shared_contract.optional_prop: mobileCardConfig is optional in data-table-responsive-types.ts:76, with no documented generated-column fallback.
shared_contract.defaults: data-table-responsive-inner.ts:269–271: enableViewToggle=true/defaultViewMode=table/mobileBreakpoint=768. resolveResponsiveViewMode switches all mobile viewport rows to card regardless of preferred table mode.
shared_contract.absent_fields: DataTableResponsiveResults passes optional fields as undefined; cardField(original,undefined) returns empty string. No data column renderer runs on the default card path. With selectionfalse and no actions, cards become blank.
shared_contract.custom_render: data-table-card-view.tsx:55–60 branches directly to custom renderCard; normal shared selection/identity/action wrappers are skipped. Custom renderer therefore owns both actual presentation and needed selection/open controls.
shared_contract.wrapper: data-table-wrapper.tsx:132–136 forces enableViewToggle=false/defaultViewMode=table/mobileBreakpoint=0 before caller config. All6current app wrapper configs omit mode overrides, so missing mobileCardConfig is intentional/safe.
